text_block_list.text:
The new year had begun. As I was thinking 
about what kind of goals to set for Mejiro 
Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Happy New Yeeeear!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
First up is muscle training?! Or maybe we 
should do some New Year's Greeting Yoga?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? Then making New Year's 
resolutions would be the thing to do, 
surely...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, how about aiming big with "A 
Great Run in the Classics!!!"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, and here I thought I was aiming 
pretty big~. Well then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“I want to supercharge my triceps surae 
muscles!!!!” Heheh, big goal, right?
choice_data_list:
How about "I'm gonna be a Triple Crown 
Umamusume!!"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Guh…… T-That's really a bit too big…… I 
can't be that bold…….

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I intend to take on the 
Classics with a determination not to lose 
to McQueen, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, I've set way too 
reckless goals and ended up crashing and 
burning, so yeah~.

It seems the deeply ingrained trauma 
cannot be dispelled. Even so... this is 
far too unsatisfying.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. In that case, Trainer, 
let's think about this together."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Have you made up your mind? Alright, here 
we go! Our grand goal! Ready, set, BAM--!!
choice_data_list: Keep the big picture in mind

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"P-P-P-Passionate love~?! What kind of 
super-steamy goal is that~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've never even had a minor romance, and 
yet... I... I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!!

She let out a scream and bolted. What on 
earth is she planning to do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So embarrassing, so embarrassing, so 
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So embarrassing, so embarrassing, so 
embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is so embarrassingggg!!

To vent out all that embarrassment, she 
went through tons of every kind of 
training imaginable. It seems to have 
boosted her Power.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Dreaming big, huh? Yeah, that's right, 
gotta go all out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Allllriiiight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaan, Trainer-san, look, look at 
this, pleaseeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I spread the banner all over the ground!! 
It says, "Gooo, Ryyy-aaan!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Open skies! Big job! Giant banner! 
Feels amazing!!

Sprawling out a massive picnic blanket and 
lying down, Mejiro Ryan wore an expression 
of absolute, refreshing satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Taikyokukan"...? That sounds like a 
pretty complicated term.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"You mean I should look at the bigger 
picture? In that case..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A planetarium! Let's gaze at the starry 
sky here and broaden our perspective!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... There's a pair over there with a 
nice atmosphere. Could it be a 
confession...? *thump-thump-thump*...

By watching the stars and observing 
people, it seems her perspective has 
broadened a little.
